I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message. I said I'd noted that Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is due 21 December, and that he's the source (14 Oct).

I couldn't check the date. There are no Thornbury files on the share, and the brain search found nothing on the account. That search ran in keyword-only mode, so it may have missed records worded differently. For now, Marcus's message is the only record of this deadline. The brain keeps his channel message on its own, so I didn't save anything separately.
